items: 🏅ABS Laser Class II <1mW 【Accurate & Reliable】 The Motover 100ft Green Cross Line Laser Level LL-T2 projects 110° self leveling laser level, ideal for indoor and outdoor use. Initial calibration required before first use， Its Rotary Laser ensures precise leveling over long distances. Compact, lightweight, with a soft grip, it’s easy to carry and drop-resistant. Rated IP54 for dust and water resistance, it’s built for tough conditions. Horizontal accuracy: ±3mm at 10m (±1/8 inch at 33 Ft). Maximum tripod load capacity: 2kg - do not exceed.

🤖【3 Adjustable Brightness Modes for Versatility】 With 3 levels of brightness adjustment, the green laser provides flexibility in power-saving mode, allowing you to work efficiently in diverse environments. The green beam offers 4x the visibility of red lasers under the same conditions. Indoor range reaches up to 100 feet, while the Rotary Laser's outdoor compatibility ensures exceptional performance even in bright conditions.

📐【25.6-inch Laser Leveling Tripod】The included laser leveling tripod is compact and lightweight when folded, easy to carry, with a convenient handle and stable 3-way pan head, the tripod leg tubes are multi-adjustable to extend the height from 9 inches to 25.6 inches for different height applications. Combined with the one-touch quick release plate design, you can set up and take down the laser level in seconds with 360-degree swivel function for tilt and swivel movement; portrait or landscape options for any angle users need.

🔋【Dual Modes for Flexible Usage】 Equipped with both Self-Leveling and Manual Modes, the laser level ensures versatility: Self-Leveling Mode: Automatically levels within 4°; the laser flashes to alert when out of range. Manual Mode: Locks the pendulum to allow manual angle adjustments for non-standard applications or when working on sloped surfaces.

📦【Comprehensive Package for Convenience】 1x 100ft Laser Level with Rotary Laser capability 1 x Aluminum Tripod 2x Batteries 1x User Manual For any questions or support, please feel free to contact us. Our professional technical team is available 24/7 to assist with any queries.

items.label: ✨Tips
items.value: To guarantee accurate operation, first install fresh batteries. Then, select the correct mode using the sliding switches: for Self-Leveling (for horizontal/vertical lines), set the top switch to OFF and the side switch to ON. If the laser flashes, it indicates an uneven surface—simply move the tool to a flatter spot. For angled lines, use Manual Mode by setting the top switch to ON and the side switch to OFF. Always turn the side switch OFF after use to preserve battery life.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1x Rotary Lasers tripod, 2 x alkaline AA Batteries, 1xOperator’s manual, 1xself-leveling Cross Line Laser Level
